name: llama-swap
title: llama-swap (model router on :8090)
description: The llama-swap proxy — one OpenAI-compatible URL on :8090; the request's model field picks the lane and triggers the load/swap. start runs it in the foreground with the same flags as start-llama-swap.ps1 (skipped when the logon copy already answers); stop unloads every lane then clears the :8090 listener, whoever started it; tui opens the lanes/loaded view with load, unload, reload and a per-lane log stream.

env.name: LLAMA_SWAP_URL
env.description: Base URL of the running llama-swap proxy (used by the tui action)

actions.name: stop
actions.confirm: Stops the router on :8090, including a copy formic did not start.
